quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: GE Vernova supports Quinbrook to deliver all three stages (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Quinbrook chose GE Vernova for stage 3 of the Supernode battery energy storage project in Queensland, Australia (order booked in Q1 2026), so GE Vernova provides power conversion, control and integration across all three stages. Stage 3 adds 260 MW and 1,216 MWh of four-hour storage, bringing Supernode to 780 MW and 3,075 MWh; GE Vernova supplies the power conversion system, plant controls, system integration and grid-connection support. It will be GE Vernova's first grid-forming battery energy storage project in Australia; stages 1 and 2 are in full operation.
quarterly_data.figure: stage 3: 260 MW and 1,216 MWh; full project 780 MW and 3,075 MWh; booked in Q1 2026
